Row 1 is Sapphire's furniture row along the back wall (all solid): desk with PC and notebook (0-1), the Hoenn map on the wall (2), GameCube (3) and TV (4), wall clock (5), stairs down (7). Black 2 has no wall clock or wall map model: the clock is the pendulum clock picture in69_clock01 (texture set 350) and the map is the framed picture art02 (interior pack 3).
